Name: Revive my grandpa
Author: Ryan029jiuyizhi
Description:
Revive My Grandpa

Description

Bring Grandpa back to life in Stardew Valley!

Revive My Grandpa is a Stardew Valley mod that gives Grandpa a second chance at life, allowing him to return to the valley and become part of your farming journey once again.

Instead of remaining only a memory, Grandpa can return as a living character and have his own cabin. The goal of this mod is to bring Grandpa back into the player’s daily life and create a new experience centered around family, farming, and adventure.

Whether you’re a longtime Stardew Valley player or starting a new farm, this mod offers a different way to experience Grandpa’s story.

This mod is currently in beta. Some features may be incomplete, experimental, or subject to change in future updates.

Installation Instructions

1. Install SMAPI, the mod loader for Stardew Valley.
2. Install Content Patcher.
3. Download and extract the Revive My Grandpa archive.
4. Open your Stardew Valley installation directory and locate the Mods folder.
5. Copy both of the following folders into Mods:
    * ReviveMyGrandpa
    * [CP] ReviveMyGrandpa
6. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
7. Check the SMAPI console for any error messages when the game starts.

Make sure both mod folders are installed directly inside the Mods directory, rather than inside an additional nested folder.

If you already have an older version installed, remove the old version’s folders before installing the new version to avoid duplicate files or conflicts.

Main Features

* Grandpa Returns: Bring Grandpa back into the world of Stardew Valley.
* Grandpa’s Cabin: Give Grandpa his own place to live in the valley.
* A New Family Experience: Make Grandpa part of your ongoing farming adventure rather than leaving him only as a memory.
* Expanded Gameplay Potential: The project is designed to give Grandpa a more active role in farm life, with planned activities involving farming, animal care, gathering, fishing, and mining.

Please note that some gameplay features may still be under development or may not be fully functional in this beta release.

Requirements

The following are required to use this mod:

* Stardew Valley — The base game.
* SMAPI — Required to load the C# mod.
* Content Patcher — Required for the content pack.

Download the required tools here:

* SMAPI: https://smapi.io/
* Content Patcher: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915

Please ensure that your installed versions of Stardew Valley, SMAPI, and Content Patcher are compatible with one another.

Shout Outs

* ConcernedApe — Thank you for creating Stardew Valley and its wonderful world, characters, and stories.
* The SMAPI Team — Thank you for providing the framework that makes Stardew Valley modding possible.
* The Content Patcher Team — Thank you for making content-based mod development more accessible.
* The Stardew Valley modding community — Thank you for sharing your knowledge, tools, and creativity with the community.

And thank you to everyone who downloads, tests, and supports this mod. Your feedback helps make future updates better!

Enjoy having Grandpa back in the valley!
